title: On chromatic number of countable graphs
summary: This paper investigates when countable graphs have a finite or an infinite chromatic number through model theoretic methods. For Fraïssé limits, we show that instability forces the chromatic number to be infinite, yielding a complete classification of homogeneous graphs with a finite chromatic number. In contrast, Hrushovski construction always produces graphs of finite chromatic number, though the value can be made arbitrarily large.
